### Headline summary
- Character.AI has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and agreed to sell assets to Disney for $20 million. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/character-ai-owes-google-law-firms-million-court-filings-show-2026-10), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/character-ai-files-bankruptcy-citing-costs-litigation), [404 Media](https://www.404media.co/character-ais-bankruptcy-documents-show-the-economics-of-ai-dont-work/), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/10/disney-offers-20m-for-character-ais-scandal-plagued-chatbot-tech/))
- Meta and Google have both released new frontier models, Muse Wonder and Gemini 4 Argon, respectively. ([MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/10/13/meta-muse-wonder-muse-wonder-full-release/), [The AI Breakdown: Daily Artificial Intel](https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/nlw/episodes/Why-Muse-Wonder-Is-Dividing-AI-Users-e3qf7l6), [Datanami](https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/13/meta-returns-to-the-ai-race-with-muse-wonder-and-a-bigger-push-into-ai-agents/), [Simon Willison's Weblog](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/13/llm-gemini/))
- The US Justice Department arrested an OpenAI engineer for allegedly planting a hidden recording device in an executive conference room. ([Artificial Intelligence Latest](https://www.wired.com/story/an-openai-employee-allegedly-used-a-chatbot-to-help-plant-a-recording-device-at-the-office/), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/13/openai-employee-arrested-hidden-recording-device), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2286084/openai-says-it-found-a-sophisticated-recording-device-hidden-in-its-offices/), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/openai-employee-arrested-allegedly-installing-office-listening-device))

### Top stories
- **Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy and Sells Assets to Disney** — Character.AI has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, citing significant legal, regulatory, and operational headwinds. The company owes nearly $7 million to Google and major law firms and has agreed to sell some of its assets to Walt Disney for $20 million. The platform is set to shut down if no other buyer emerges, though it plans to continue operations during the sale process. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/character-ai-owes-google-law-firms-million-court-filings-show-2026-10), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/character-ai-files-bankruptcy-citing-costs-litigation), [404 Media](https://www.404media.co/character-ais-bankruptcy-documents-show-the-economics-of-ai-dont-work/), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/10/disney-offers-20m-for-character-ais-scandal-plagued-chatbot-tech/))
- **OpenAI Employee Arrested for Planting Hidden Recording Device** — The US Justice Department arrested OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan for allegedly installing a sophisticated recording device in an executive conference room. The device was intended to intercept communications regarding the company's superintelligence technology. ([Artificial Intelligence Latest](https://www.wired.com/story/an-openai-employee-allegedly-used-a-chatbot-to-help-plant-a-recording-device-at-the-office/), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/13/openai-employee-arrested-hidden-recording-device), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2286084/openai-says-it-found-a-sophisticated-recording-device-hidden-in-its-offices/), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/openai-employee-arrested-allegedly-installing-office-listening-device))
- **Meta Releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full Models** — Meta has launched Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its most capable models to date, designed for long-running personal and professional AI agent workloads. The company claims these models deliver state-of-the-art performance on agentic tasks, marking a shift in its AI strategy with new pricing and access limits. Mark Zuckerberg stated that Meta considered a $200 billion AI investment in late 202… ([MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/10/13/meta-muse-wonder-muse-wonder-full-release/), [The AI Breakdown: Daily Artificial Intel](https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/nlw/episodes/Why-Muse-Wonder-Is-Dividing-AI-Users-e3qf7l6), [Datanami](https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/13/meta-returns-to-the-ai-race-with-muse-wonder-and-a-bigger-push-into-ai-agents/), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/meta-unveiled-new-frontier-model-it-expands-its-ai-footprint-its-stock-climbing-3808529))
- **Google Rolls Out Gemini 4 Argon Globally** — Google has made Gemini 4 Argon, its latest frontier model, available worldwide via the Gemini API and to subscribers of its AI Pro and Ultra plans. The model features a new tasks mode, a unified 1 million token limit, and capabilities in coding, robotics, and knowledge work. ([Simon Willison's Weblog](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/13/llm-gemini/), [AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/13/gemini-4-argon-reaches-gemini-app-pro-and-ultra-subscribers-alongside-a-new-tasks-mode/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/gemini-4-argon-is-now-available-worldwide-as-googles-most-capable-frontier-model/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261013/p30#a261013p30))
- **Judge Orders OpenAI to Provide Forensic Data in Apple Lawsuit** — A federal judge granted Apple's motion for expedited discovery in its trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI. The court ordered OpenAI to hand over forensic images of devices and hiring records involving former Apple employees. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261013/p44#a261013p44), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/judge-grants-apple-expedited-discovery-in-openai-trade-secrets-case/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/13/judge-orders-openai-to-turn-over-hiring-records-in-apple-trade-secrets-case/))
- **Anthropic Warns of Imminent 'AI Worms' on Smart Devices** — Anthropic researchers warned that AI models are months away from becoming self-replicating 'AI worms'. These systems could infiltrate and spread across internet-connected smart home devices without human intervention. ([Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/13/anthropic-ai-replicators-warning), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/anthropic-warns-ai-worms), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-10-anthropic-ai-worms-smart-gadgets.html))
- **IMF Warns AI Boom Poses Financial Stability Risks** — The International Monetary Fund reported that while AI investment is supporting global growth, the sector's high valuations and debt levels pose risks to financial stability. The IMF warned that a correction in the artificial intelligence market could trigger global financial turmoil, with 40% of jobs potentially affected. ([Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-imf-ai-investment-global-growth-jobs/), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/oct/13/ai-share-crash-risk-global-imf-debt-corrowing-cyber-attacks), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VP559U1mieE), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/ai-could-affect-4-10-jobs-worldwide-imf-chief-warns-slow-moving-tsunami-3808475))
- **Microsoft Unveils Maia 300 AI Chip and Reorganizes Azure** — Microsoft announced the Maia 300, its third-generation custom AI chip optimized for reasoning models and agents, which it plans to use as its primary inference system. The company is also overhauling the leadership of its Azure cloud business and consolidating units to reorient itself around artificial intelligence. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KLNyxEj4ReM), [Computerworld](https://www.computerworld.com/article/4234722/microsoft-unveils-new-maia-300-ai-chip.html), [The Stack](https://www.thestack.technology/microsoft-will-soon-run-its-services-primarily-on-custom-chips/), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/exclusive-microsoft-reorganizes-azure-cloud-unit-amid-ai-overhaul))
